services.name: Surf Camps
services.desc: Everyday California is proud to be a part of the local surfing culture and offers rental surfboards and boogie boards for anybody looking to have fun in the waves. The surf in the La Jolla Shores area is great for beginners, so you don’t have to be a professional surfer to have a great time out in the water! Please note that we give a safety briefing to each renter, but we do not provide surf lessons for rentals. If you're new to surfing and would like to learn how, we recommend you check out our surf lessons first. We offer a range of beginner soft-top surfboards from 6 to 9 feet long, as well as performance surfboards for intermediate and advanced surfers. Stop by the shop to pick one up,

gap: Duration of tours and lessons not stated
blurb: Everyday California offers guided kayak tours through the La Jolla Ecological Reserve, surf camps and lessons, and rentals of kayaks, surfboards, and stand up paddle boards. Tours are suitable for almost everyone 5 years and older with no experience needed. Their Huntington Beach location offers rentals to explore the calm waters of Huntington Harbour.

quotes.text: The kayak tour was so much fun! Devin and Christian were amazing guides and made us feel really safe and at ease when going out into the ocean. I would go back again and hope everyone considers doing a tour with everyday California!

The sea cave kayak tour was amazing, or as my 10yo daughter said, “an experience of a lifetime”! We got to see dolphins and sea lions near us, which we realize is a special treat. We would definitely do it again!
I really enjoyed the 2hr kayak and snorkeling tour. It was my first time snorkeling and my kayaking on the ocean. The guides were very helpful. I had a great first experience!
